policy.measure: GDP/value added, not shipments, gross output, or total sales
policy.motorVehiclesScope: motor vehicles, bodies, trailers, and parts as published; not Census 3361 alone
policy.otherTransportScope: other transportation equipment as published; broader than aerospace 3364
policy.examProvenance: The six displayed category names align closely with this classification, but the original question does not cite a publisher or define production value. Current revised 2024 percentages are NOT the question given.
policy.noAutomaticReplacement: Never fill Census suppressed shipment cells with BEA GDP. Do not combine current-dollar values with chained-dollar GDP.
